name: unit
what: no real time, no sockets, no network, no outside services or toolchains beyond the Go test binary; stays inside its working directory

name: functional
what: uses a real thing: a compiler or VM, a toolchain, generated code built and run; per pull request on runners that provide it

name: nightly
what: heavy or long: long fuzz, full matrices, soak, timing, anything past a two-minute job even sharded

name: roundtrip
what: read bytes, write them back, same bytes
contract: read the bytes the inputs give as the named root of the named schema with the language's generated reader, write the value back with its generated writer, and pass only when the bytes written equal the bytes read

name: encode
what: a value written from scratch gives exactly the expected bytes
contract: build the value the inputs describe from scratch with the language's generated code, write it, and pass only when the bytes equal the expected bytes the inputs give

name: decode
what: bytes read give exactly the expected value
contract: read the bytes the inputs give as the named root, and pass only when every field read equals the expected value the inputs give

name: write-refusal
what: writing a bad value is refused (debug assert in the assert legs; every build in the refuse legs)
contract: build the bad value the inputs describe and write it: in a language whose write rule is assert, a debug build with asserts on must stop the write by assert; in a language whose rule is refuse, every build must refuse it; pass on the refusal, judged by verdict only

name: load-refusal
what: hostile bytes are refused in every build, with the named reason
contract: read the hostile bytes the inputs give as the named root, in a release build, and pass only when the read refuses, judged by verdict only; a read that lands a value, crashes or hangs fails

name: codegen
what: generated source compiles and is clean
contract: generate the language's code for the schema the inputs name and build it with the language's own toolchain; pass only when it builds with no error and no warning

name: golden
what: the generated source or output for a schema and language equals its pinned file
contract: generate the language's code or output for the schema the inputs name, and pass only when it equals the pinned file the inputs name byte for byte; a missing pin fails, and only a run of this test with -update re-pins

name: name-check
what: a schema's names are accepted or refused by the name checker
contract: run the name checker on the schema the inputs name, and pass only when it accepts or refuses as the expected result says

name: evolution
what: one schema version reads or writes another's data
contract: write the data with one schema version and read it with the other, as the inputs name, and pass only when the result is the expected one

name: fuzz
what: seeded mutations
contract: run the seeded mutations the inputs give (the seed and the budget are inputs, never time) through the language's reader, and pass only when every mutated input is read or refused, with no crash, hang or out-of-bounds access

name: plant
what: a negative control: a named test run against a deliberately broken build must come out red
contract: run the target test the inputs name against a build broken as the inputs say (an environment, or source edits that each land exactly once, built with the flags of the leg it breaks), and pass only when the target runs and fails

name: compiler
what: the compiler or IR itself (parse, check, plan), with no generated language involved
contract: run the compiler check the inputs name (parse, check or plan) and pass only when it passes; language-free

name: tooling
what: CI policy, docs, roadmap, repo-structure and harness self-tests
contract: run the Go test or script the inputs name, and pass only when it passes; language-free

name: bench
what: performance or timing
contract: measure what the inputs name, and pass only when the measurement is within the bound recorded in the inputs

name: lint
what: generated or runtime code is clean under the language's strict analyser
contract: run the language's strict analyser over the tree the inputs name; any finding fails

name: differential
what: two implementations or two versions give the same answer
contract: run both implementations or versions the inputs name on the same input, and pass only when their answers are equal

name: soak
what: long-running repeated use, with no leak or drift
contract: repeat the use the inputs name for the count they give (a count, never a duration), and pass only when nothing leaks or drifts

name: resource-bounds
what: memory, allocation and depth limits are held
contract: drive the language's code to the memory, allocation or depth limit the inputs name, and pass only when the limit holds and a breach is refused

name: model
what: a TLA+ model checks under TLC, or a code trace is a behaviour of the spec
contract: run TLC on the model and config the inputs name, or check the code's trace against the spec; a counterexample, or a trace that is not a behaviour of the spec, fails

name: pr
what: the pull-request tier: unit and functional tests of every language whose adapter has landed, and every language-free test

name: nightly
what: everything, every language: a language with no adapter is red here, and its red count is its remaining work

the go align-arrays harness reports a row red when its expectation is turned around: the run cannot pass a row it did not check
the lua align-arrays harness reports a row red when its expectation is turned around: the run cannot pass a row it did not check
the committed spec addenda (docs/SPEC-TESTS*.md) are exactly what the registry generates: a hand edit, a row added without regenerating, a missing page or a leftover page is red
plant: a hand edit to a generated addendum makes the drift check fail, naming the page and the line
plant: a registry row added without regenerating makes the drift check fail, naming its tier's page
plant: a deleted addendum page, and a page the registry no longer generates, each make the drift check fail by name
plant: a test with no checks text or no expect, a type with no adapter contract, a test of an undeclared tier or type, and inputs that do not decode each fail generation, by name
a refusal's expected result in the addenda is its verdict only; reason text in the row is never written
an input value too long to copy is named in the addenda by the registry field that holds it, never copied
every test's full name is on its own tier's addendum and no other, every language is on the contract page, and every unrepresentable pair is listed
a tier row carrying an adapter contract is refused by the loader, naming the line
text with column bars, markup and backtick runs stays one table cell of literal text in the addenda
schema-test addenda --check exits 0 against the repository's pages and 1 naming a missing page, and refuses a stray argument
schema-test addenda writes every generated page, removes a stale one, and stops naming the page on a failed write or remove
